summary: SPHEREview is an interactive application that allows you to explore NASA’s SPHEREx infrared observations. By comparing images of the sky taken on different dates, you can investigate the motion of objects and changes in their brightness; you can also examine the spectra of selected sources. The Gaia, CatWISE, and NASA JPL catalogs also provide additional location, motion, and identification information for these sources. The application helps identify variable stars, moving objects, and other potential discovery candidates.
details:
SPHEREview: Detecting Motion and Change in the Infrared Sky Using NASA SPHEREx Data

Project Function and Operating Principle

SPHEREview is a web-based analysis tool developed for the “Planet X and SPHEREx” mission as part of the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. The system displays sequential NASA SPHEREx images of a specified region, captured at different dates. This allows for the detection of objects that have changed in position or brightness; it also provides real-time access to the spectra and light curves of selected sources.

Benefits

As a free, open-source system, it consolidates various analytical processes into a single interface and has been successfully validated against the mission’s test targets.

Intended Impact

The project aims to enable students and citizen scientists to easily access the SPHEREx archive and identify candidate celestial objects.

Tools, Programming Languages, Hardware, and Software

The project was developed using Python, FastAPI, Astropy, PyTorch, and JavaScript. It utilizes NASA archive data and runs on a standard computer. The development process was supported by the AI ​​assistant Claude (by Anthropic).

Unique and Creative Aspects

The system integrates measurements from different exposures to generate real-time spectra and evaluates candidate objects, providing the reasoning behind each assessment.

Factors Considered by the Team

Scientific accuracy was prioritized; detections are presented not as confirmed discoveries, but as candidates requiring further investigation.
